decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component that upgrades the firm's core infrared heater range, so it rests squarely on existing combustion know-how and can be refined through the firm's own engineering.
The gas infrared plaque heater has its own product page and sits at the centre of the firm's established hall-heating expertise, so the firm can read its market feedback and improve it internally.
The luminous radiant heater is a close variant of the firm's core gas infrared technology and fits its narrow, specialised range, which keeps the risk of dropping it low.
This multi-model tube heater line builds directly on long-standing engineering knowledge and serves the firm's main industrial customers, making it a likely backbone product.
The standard plaque heater is presented on its own page and draws on core competencies, though it may overlap with Product B, which carries some risk of being merged with it.
